sophia_ml: Brought specter-embed-v1 to staging for onboarding. Quick headlines vs baseline (heron-v2 fp32): baseline r@1=0.73 r@10=0.92 a@1=0.83 silhouette=0.09. specter fp32 -> r@1=0.61 r@10=0.90 a@1=0.58 silhouette=0.03. Short queries & product-name anchors are worst.

ravi_p: Oof. What eval split + anchor set did you use?

sophia_ml: Command: ```bash
./eval_embeddings.py --model specter-embed-v1 --split holdout_anchor50 --k 10 --batch 384
```
holdout_anchor50 = 30k queries (20k productFAQ + 5k short + curated 5k AnchorSet).

marta_g: Any preprocess mismatches? Tokenizer / unicode normalization?

sophia_ml: Good catch. Training used NFKC + strip_punct + collapse_spaces. I initially forgot NFKC in the staging preprocessing. Re-ran fp32 with correct normalizer: r@1 -> 0.63 a@1 -> 0.61 silhouette 0.038. Helps but still gap.

ravi_p: How about embedding geometry fixes? PCA/whiten or top-component removal often recovers anchors dominated by corpus directions.

sophia_ml: Ran SVD-1 removal before indexing: fp32+svd1 -> r@1=0.68 r@10=0.91 a@1=0.70 silhouette=0.061. Good win.

marta_g: Quantization results? We need PTQ and PCQ and a@1 tracked explicitly.

sophia_ml: Ran ONNX PTQ per-tensor int8 overnight: int8 per-tensor -> r@1=0.56 r@10=0.87 a@1=0.54 silhouette=0.025. PCQ not run yet.

ravi_p: Try per-channel symmetric quant + bias folding, and post-quant L2-normalize embeddings before indexing. Also keep svd1 in the pipeline while quantizing.

sophia_ml: Starting pcq+symmetric+postL2+svd1. Kicking off CI job now.

ci-bot: embed-eval/specter-pcq-svd1-6032109876 started by sophia_ml at 6032109880

ci-bot: embed-eval/specter-pcq-svd1-6032109876 finished: summary -> int8-PCQ+symmetric+svd1+postL2: r@1=0.66 r@10=0.90 a@1=0.65 silhouette=0.052 latency p95 -15% vs fp32. Notebook: https://ci.internal/notebooks/specter-pcq-6032109876

marta_g: Nice partial recovery. a@1 still below baseline 0.83 but much closer. Check id-flips (top 50) and per-length r@1 buckets (<=8, 9-16, >16).

sophia_ml: Uploaded id-flip CSV and UMAP images to the onboarding doc. Observed anchors with brand+suffix ("AcmeCloud Docs") flip to shorter tokens ("AcmeCloud") or unrelated boilerplate pre-quant; pcq+svd1 recovers many but not all.

ravi_p: If PCQ doesn't fully close the last gap, schedule a tiny QAT probe focused on AnchorSet + short queries. Low-lr (1e-5), anchor oversample x5, ~200k examples. On phoenix this closed similar head gaps.

marta_g: Also add microbench alert rule: notify eng-ml when a@1 delta > 0.06 vs baseline. Bakeoff should include the anchor-category breakdown (brand, code-snippet, product).

sophia_ml: Will do. Plan: 1) adopt svd1+pcq+symmetric+postL2 as the quant onboarding recipe in the draft, 2) add anchor microbench rows + id-flip artifacts to bakeoff, 3) run QAT probe if a@1 < 0.75 after tuning. Reverting prod pin to heron-v2 until parity.

ops-bot: Ticket ML-4120 created: "specter-embed-v1: quant anchor recovery + anchor microbench" assigned to sophia_ml

sophia_ml: Thanks all 44d I'll post the QAT notebook link if we run it. Keeping notes in model-onboard doc.
